scope: Representation payload accounting, not certified runtime memory peak or end-to-end training budget.

variables.R: sum of step factor ranks r_s

rational_codec: Actual reported bytes include a 16-byte dimension/rank header followed by every exact numerator and denominator in unsigned-varint encoding (numerators zigzag signed). No assumption of 4 bytes per rational; files independently decoded. Codec represents ideal exact-real moments, not original sequential FP32 moments.

fixed_power2_constructive_exception.scope: Synthetic 8x8 pattern, 64 finite tested steps. Metadata is an explicit representation budget, not a measured native codec/runtime allocation.
fixed_power2_constructive_exception.restrictions: Zero initial moments; every gradient has the same fixed positive separable power-of-two pattern; all relevant intermediate operations remain normal finite in this tested sequence.

must_add_for_any_actual_runtime: Current weights and any master weights; dtype explicit
Step count, dimensions, ranks, pointer/offset metadata, beta and bias-correction constants
Reserved history/merge buffers; no counting only used prefix
Old and new factors simultaneously during merge
not_claimed: A low-memory runtime or full training memory budget
A lower bound on the size of arbitrary codecs
Full exact matrix rank implies incompressibility
